summary: The market closed with broad-based gains of about 1.3%, recovering most of Thursday's fall. Midcaps outperformed and smallcaps finished higher too.

up.summary: IT led the rebound, with Fortis and midcaps also strong at the close
up.why: TCS's Q2 drove a sector-wide IT rally, and lower oil and a milder-than-feared drug cap brought buyers back into beaten-down midcaps and hospitals.
